subject.title: [Feature]: GitHub Copilot provider cannot reach GitHub Enterprise data-residency (*.ghe.com) tenants

question: Should OpenClaw accept GitHub Enterprise data-residency routing inside the bundled github-copilot provider, including tenant-domain env/config input and token-host selection, or keep GHE Copilot outside core as plugin/ClawHub scope?
rationale: VISION.md favors setup reliability and major provider support, but the requested fix changes provider auth routing and token egress for an existing bundled provider, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Accept narrow bundled-provider routing
options.body: Review and harden the linked PR so the existing github-copilot provider supports allowlisted public GitHub and GHE data-residency hosts without changing the default github.com path.

options.title: Route to external plugin scope
options.body: Close this issue and the linked PR as plugin/ClawHub work, accepting that the bundled github-copilot provider remains unusable for GHE data-residency tenants.

options.title: Require a generic host-routing API first
options.body: Keep the issue open but pause the linked PR until maintainers define a reusable provider-auth host-routing contract.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow bundled-provider routing
recommendation.body: Review and harden the linked PR so the existing github-copilot provider supports allowlisted public GitHub and GHE data-residency hosts without changing the default github.com path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent current-main signal across the bundled Copilot provider/auth paths and is the best available routing owner for the product/security decision.
